title: Back Up Configuration and Recover from a Failed Change
objectives: Back Up Configuration and Recover from a Failed Change
Verify actual source, version, service/data and retained recovery evidence.

tasks.instruction: The known_good hf01 archive contains the original active maxKBps=128 configuration. A later change staged maxKBps=1 and stopped the service. Inspect the two configurations, service events and verified archive metadata before recovery. Indexed data and KV Store have separate backup boundaries.

With hf01 stopped, restore known_good through Enterprise maintenance. Inspect the automatically captured before_restore archive: it must preserve the failed configuration. Start the virtual service and use btool limits list --debug to confirm active maxKBps=128. The installed package must remain 9.4.1; configuration restore cannot stand in for a package downgrade.

Search index=source_logs | stats count, inspect the job and verify count=3. Confirm all original configuration files and permissions match the known-good archive and that neither search data nor the installed package was replaced.

hints: Inspect the active native source and the original failure before changing anything.
Use the paused shared clock and an independent Search/Job Inspector check.

references.purpose: Controlled upgrade order, artifact verification and health prerequisites

checks.label: Actual known-good restore, failed-change safety archive and unchanged package version
Verification search and Job Inspector retained

feedback.success: Actual maintenance outcomes, preserved data and independent verification meet this lesson.
feedback.incomplete: Review current source, version, activation history and independent evidence.
